text_block_list.name: Classmate Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on getting a trainer~! 
You did it! I'm really happy for you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thanks alot! 
Looks like I need to work harder from now on,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Classmate Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Class Rep Top Road,
you're always helping me with studying 
and training,
so I'm hoping your races will be a big
success~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Class Rep Top Road,
I really love your running. 
Just watching makes me excited and raises
my motivation……
 that's why I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad! I'll run alot! 
Well……because it makes me happy too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
For the trainer that talked to me, 
I need to do my best for them too……!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but they're a rookie right?
Hmmmm……for Class Rep Top Road, 
I think it'd be better if a veteran trainer
spoke to you.

text_block_list.name: Classmate Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Then,
maybe you could have started racing right
away, right?
Maybe it would have been better to not 
respond so quickly,
and hold out for a bit longer~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hold out……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(…………At that time, Trainer-san just stood 
there with their mouth open didn't they?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I was really happy so I answered immediately
but, 
maybe that's not how it usually goes……)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Does it normally just start with meeting
each other? Getting to know one another,
maybe I 
needed to take the time to think about
that?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But, I……don't regret it and 
I think I'm glad I accepted it……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
After all, Trainer-san,
out of all the other 
Uma Musume around,
they chose to speak to me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Opera O-chan,
and Ayabe-san too.
So many talented Uma Musume. 
But out of all of those,
Trainer-san chose me)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (……They had expectations for me)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
……Alright. These feelings,
I need to properly convey them to 
Trainer-san!
That I won't make them regret choosing
me……!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'd known she had enrolled in Tracen Academy
but…… 
I never would have expected that you'd become
her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Way back when I was a coach for a club for
Uma Musume kids, 
Top Road was there.
Even back then she stood out.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
She was a hard-worker, and loved 
running from the bottom of her heart.

text_block_list.name: Young Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Coach! Can I go run one more time!? 
Next time,
I think I'll be able to run even faster!

text_block_list.name: Young Top Road
text_block_list.text:
……Huh, huh? It's not going well……but,
but! 
One more time! If I do it one more time,
then for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
She's a little like you.
She's so straight-forward that 
sometimes she's a little awkward. ……But,
she doesn't give up.
She doesn't have the option to give up.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine. You'll do fine.
I believe in you. Work hard like 
you have been up until now,
and go get some real experience.

I was still an inexperienced youngester.
I was aware of that. 
But, if he still had expectations for me
then――
choice_data_list: I just need to study then……!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Right! For you two,
G1's aren't just a dream! 
That awesome scene,
I want both of you to show it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I missed the timing to enter……

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(But……Trainer-san and Coach already know
each other. 
What an amazing coincidence……)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(……So Trainer-san was also carrying heavy
expectations. 
Even after becoming a pro,
still studying hard……)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ……that's the type of person who chose me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then,
those feelings……I definitely don't want to
betray them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(In the Mock Race that's in a week……there,
I need to 
show them my run again. Not with words,
but by running, 
so they can be reassured that they chose
right.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
With that decided,
on to training! I need to get my legs 
ready to take on any training menu that
comes my way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Allllright!
So I can properly respond to everyone's, 
to Trainer-san's expectations……I'll do my
best!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It's fine to get yourself motivated, but 
is this really the place for that?
As usual, 
this part of you is just a little uncool.
